name: activity-lens-mobile
description: Capacitor Android shell for Activity Lens. The web app lives in ../frontend.

scripts.sync: pnpm run check-versions && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: pnpm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: pnpm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleRelease
